# REL-44: Adaptive routing strategy measured against the rule-based baseline

Status: **Done** | Phase 4 - Optimization | Owner: Claude | issue #35

## Outcome

Adaptive routing strategy measured against the rule-based baseline

## Depends on

- [REL-43](REL-43.md) Routing experiment harness comparing strategies on seeded scenarios - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-59](REL-59.md) Deterministic routing seed for every payment

## Acceptance

- [x] Beats the rule-based router on the agreed objective across seeded scenarios, or the result is documented honestly
- [x] Owner decision 2026-11-06 (REL-42 plan review, ADR-0016): the adaptive strategy is Thompson sampling: a Beta-Bernoulli posterior per processor over a recent, decaying window of outcomes, standard library only (`random.betavariate`), no new dependency
- [x] The learned state lives in shared storage (PostgreSQL or Valkey), not one worker's memory, so several worker processes and a restart see the same posterior (PR-6)
- [x] The sampler's random draws are seeded from the payment `reference` (ADR-0012), so a paired run repeats exactly; a test runs the same references twice and gets the same routing
- [x] Owner decision 2026-11-06 (REL-42 plan review, ADR-0016): the adaptive strategy wins when, across 3 scenarios x 5 seeds against `rules`, the mean paired success-rate uplift is at least 1 percentage point, it is better on at least 80% of paired runs, and p95 latency is not worse by more than the margin ADR-0016 states; otherwise the result is reported honestly as not winning
- [x] The exploration cost is reported: the share of payments routed to the processor that was degraded at the time, per scenario
- [x] `rules` stays the default; the strategy never waits on a model call (ADR-0012)
- [x] A payment routed by the adaptive strategy carries a new routed reason `adaptive`: added to `RoutedReason`, to the `payment_events` reason CHECK by a migration, to the rule-based explainer's texts and to any UI reason labels, with tests (PR-23); its posterior is computed from recent `payment_events` in PostgreSQL the way `app/routing/health.py` computes health, so no new table is needed unless the ADR says otherwise

## Steps

1. **REL-44.1 Agree the objective and write failing tests** (done) - Record the measure to beat (for example revenue recovered) and add tests comparing strategies on fixed seeds.
2. **REL-44.2 Implement the adaptive strategy** (done) - In `api/app/routing/`, add a free, open-source learning approach such as a bandit that uses recent outcomes.
3. **REL-44.3 Wire it behind a switch** (done) - Select the strategy by configuration so the rule-based router stays the default.
4. **REL-44.4 Run the experiment harness on all seeded scenarios** (done) - Compare against the rule-based baseline across all seeds and record the numbers in `docs/evaluation/`, whether or not it wins.
5. **REL-44.5 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - CI is green, the reviewer confirms correctness against the requirements, the maintainer approves, and the pull request is squash-merged with the issue closed.
